selected_scope: Named Imari East Industrial Park parent-property locator

selected_locator.precision: Published marker for the specifically named Imari East Industrial Park parent property; not a surveyed DayOne parcel, building, phase boundary or active work extent.
selected_locator.identity_review: DayOne and Imari City identify Imari East Industrial Park. Saga prefecture guide identifies a single approximately 13.6 ha park with one approximately 7 ha industrial plateau in Matsuuracho Yamagata. Nikkan Kogyo embeds these coordinates beneath that exact park name. The map point is used only at parent-property scope.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: Publisher gives no measured horizontal accuracy or datum realization. Six decimal places are retained from embedded map attributes and do not imply survey precision.
